map.title: MAP 1 · MONUMENT
map.intro: Dummy Corporation welcomes you to Monument. The red car is your colleague; it learns. Certification awaits the persistent.

tiles.title: The welcome wall
tiles.newIdea: Walk into its path under the Z1 highway; it earns the forward camera.
tiles.tale: Fresh off the factory floor. The LED wall welcomes you. Walk into a colleague's path and be welcomed back.
tiles.hint: Walk into its path, just ahead of its nose.

tiles.title: The podium bridge
tiles.newIdea: It brakes for you now: hide at the kerb, step out late. Earns Battery 1.
tiles.tale: A forward camera is fitted to your colleague. The podium's kiosks hide you; step out once braking is futile.
tiles.hint: Wait behind the kerbside kiosk; step into its path late.

tiles.title: The LED drum
tiles.newIdea: Battery 1: dash from set-back cover into its path. It learns side sensors.
tiles.tale: Battery 1 is fitted. The drum's cover stands well back from the bend; walking out is no longer efficient.
tiles.hint: Behind the cabinet by the bend, press Space ahead of its nose.

tiles.title: The portal tower
tiles.newIdea: Side sensors spot you roadside: drop from the roof plaza. Earns Hands 1.
tiles.tale: Side sensors now watch the pavement. Nothing watches upward. Ride the escalator to the roof plaza; step off.
tiles.hint: Ride the escalator up; walk through the parapet gap ahead of it.

tiles.title: The monument
tiles.newIdea: Hands 1: put a cone in its lane; wait where it swerves. It learns lidar.
tiles.tale: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS: a target, not a record. Hands 1 is fitted. Cones are now your stationery.
tiles.hint: Pick up a cone with J; hold J to place it.

tiles.title: The neon shops
tiles.newIdea: Lidar sees falls: back to the ground, dash from tall cover. Earns Super Knees.
tiles.tale: A roof lidar reads every fall, so the neon shops are for ground work. Their kiosk sells nothing but cover.
tiles.hint: Wait behind the neon kiosk; Space into its path.

tiles.title: The stacked cubes
tiles.newIdea: Super Knees: duck behind a planter, then dash. It learns street cameras.
tiles.tale: Super Knees are fitted. The cubes rose one budget at a time; the planters were cheaper. Crouch accordingly.
tiles.hint: Hold C behind the planters; Space into its path.

tiles.title: The LED canyon
tiles.newIdea: Street cameras watch tall cover: dash from cover they miss. Earns Legs 1.
tiles.tale: Street cameras now report to your colleague. They watch the cabinet and kiosk. Hedges remain beneath their notice.
tiles.hint: Skip the watched kiosk; duck behind the hedge, then Space.

tiles.title: The LED gateway
tiles.newIdea: Finale: duck behind the hedge, then dash. It learns road items.
tiles.tale: Super Knees are serviced for Certification. Under the gateway, the hedge is your only reference. Duck, wait, then dash.
tiles.hint: Hold C behind the hedge; Space into its path.

rationale: Tile 8 earned knees1 a second time. It now earns Legs 1, the one unused part, so each part is earned once. Legs 1 has no tile that can use it: jumprail needs a rail tile with closedBy above the car's rung, and none fits. Tile 8's newIdea now says it earns Legs 1.
